name: curl
resume: Checked curl_modify_url, curl_options_table, and curl_symbols. Escape, URL parsing, downloads, streams, headers, dates, and hostname lookup call libcurl or the system resolver. find_port binds a local socket. curl_echo waits on httpuv. curl_modify_url is written and not checked, because the installed R package is 6.2.1. 34 of 44 exports are checked.

functions.name: curl_escape
functions.done: Percent-encode a string with libcurl.

check.case: escape a space, equals, and plus

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(curl))
one <- function() {
  curl_escape("foo = bar + 5")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

proof.python:
import statistics
import time
from curl import curl_parse_url

def one():
    u = curl_parse_url("https://jerry:secret@google.com:888/foo/bar?test=123#bla")
    params = "|".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in u["params"].items())
    return "|".join([u["url"], u["scheme"], u["host"], u["port"], u["path"], u["user"], u["password"], u["fragment"], params])

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
if isinstance(value, bool):
    shown = "TRUE" if value else "FALSE"
elif value is None:
    shown = "NULL"
else:
    shown = str(value).replace("\n", " / ")
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

import statistics
import time
from curl import new_handle, new_pool, multi_add, multi_run, multi_cancel

def one():
    import tempfile
    handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)
    handle.write(b"Zed")
    handle.close()
    got = ["none"]
    h = new_handle(url="file://" + handle.name)
    pool = new_pool()
    multi_add(h, done=lambda data: got.append("ran"), pool=pool)

    multi_run(pool)
    return got[-1] if "ran" not in got else "ran"
